name: inspect_data
title: Inspect Data as Types
description: Reads up to 16 bytes at an address and interprets them as every common data type at once (signed/unsigned integers of width 8/16/24/32/48/64, 32/64-bit floats, bool, char, ULEB128, 32/64-bit Unix timestamps, and UUID/GUID). Like ImHex's Data Inspector. Use the 'types' filter to limit the output.

types.description: Optional list of interpretation names to return (e.g. ['u32','f32','time32']). Returns all if omitted

interpretations.description: Map of type name to interpreted value
